question: Please calculate the monthly average levels of PM10, PM2.5 FRM, PM2.5 non-FRM, volatile organic emissions, SO2 (scaled by a factor of 10), and Lead (scaled by a factor of 100) air pollutants in California for the year 2020.
sql:
WITH pm10 AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) as month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) as avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm10_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_frm AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) as month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) as avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_frm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_nonfrm AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) as month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) as avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_nonfrm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
voc AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) as month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) as avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
so2 AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) as month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 10 as avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
lead AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) as month,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 as avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.lead_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
)
SELECT month, 'PM10' as pollutant, ROUND(avg_value, 4) as avg_value FROM pm10
UNION ALL SELECT month, 'PM2.5 FRM', ROUND(avg_value, 4) FROM pm25_frm
UNION ALL SELECT month, 'PM2.5 non-FRM', ROUND(avg_value, 4) FROM pm25_nonfrm
UNION ALL SELECT month, 'Volatile Organic Emissions', ROUND(avg_value, 4) FROM voc
UNION ALL SELECT month, 'SO2', ROUND(avg_value, 4) FROM so2
UNION ALL SELECT month, 'Lead', ROUND(avg_value, 4) FROM lead
ORDER BY month, pollutant
